$comment: Standing rule 1 made mechanical. Generated by scripts/check-literals.mjs --write; every reason is written by a human and CI fails on an entry that has none. A number in this list is a claim that it is NOT a rate. If you cannot write that claim honestly, the number belongs in the registry with a source_url and a verified_at.

packages/calibrate/src/priors.ts|100.reason: PERCENT — percentile scale in nearestRank. Unit conversion.

packages/calibrate/src/priors.ts|50.reason: P50 — the median, the percentile rule 3 requires. Definitional.

packages/calibrate/src/priors.ts|90.reason: P90 — the other percentile rule 3 requires. Definitional.

packages/contracts/src/estimate.ts|100.reason: Percent bound on a share field (min 0, max 100). A unit ceiling, not a rate.

packages/contracts/src/estimate.ts|3.reason: Arity of a fixed tuple/enum the contract defines. Changes only when the shape does.

packages/contracts/src/ingest.ts|64.reason: Length of a sha256 hex digest (256 bits / 4 bits per hex char). Definitional.

packages/contracts/src/ingest.ts|9.reason: Upper bound of the hex digit class in the sha256 regex ([0-9a-f]). Structural.

packages/contracts/src/instance.ts|1024.reason: Base of the binary GiB conversion in BYTES_PER_GIB. Definitional, cannot go stale.

packages/contracts/src/instance.ts|3.reason: Exponent in 1024**3. Part of the same definitional conversion.

packages/contracts/src/pricing.ts|3.reason: Arity of a fixed enum in this file.

packages/contracts/src/pricing.ts|864000.reason: Milliseconds per day, for the rate-freshness age comparison. Calendar arithmetic.

packages/contracts/src/provenance.ts|3.reason: Rank ceiling of the four-value Confidence ladder (NONE..HIGH).

packages/contracts/src/request.ts|1e-9.reason: Float tolerance for comparing a combined multiplier against the product of its factors.

packages/contracts/src/workflow.ts|0.02.reason: Tolerance on proportion sums (payload_languages, script_mix) that must total 1.

packages/contracts/src/workflow.ts|200.reason: Max length of a free-text label. A storage bound, not a quantity in the cost math.

packages/contracts/src/workflow.ts|3.reason: Arity of a fixed enum in this file.

packages/estimator/src/candidate.ts|3.reason: Arity of a fixed tuple in this file.

packages/estimator/src/context.ts|0.1.reason: TIER_PROXIMITY_WARN_PCT — how close to a tier bound triggers a warning. A UI threshold, named, and overridable per call. Not a published figure.

packages/estimator/src/request.ts|1000.reason: Divisor converting a published per_1k_calls rate to per-call. The RATE comes from the registry; only the unit conversion is here.

packages/estimator/src/selfhosted.ts|0.1.reason: Lower bound of the utilization sanity band. A labelled modelling parameter.

packages/estimator/src/selfhosted.ts|0.2.reason: LOW_UTILIZATION_WARN_THRESHOLD — when to warn that a GPU is mostly idle. A warning threshold, not a price.

packages/estimator/src/selfhosted.ts|0.5.reason: Two distinct 0.5s, both named constants. (1) Bytes per parameter at int4 — definitional to the dtype, and the comment beside it records that a real int4 checkpoint occupies more. (2) VISUAL_CONTEXT_DOMINANCE_THRESHOLD — the share of a context window above which images are said to dominate it; a reporting threshold, not a published figure.

packages/estimator/src/selfhosted.ts|0.9.reason: Lower probe point either side of the breakeven crossover, for the sensitivity curve. A plotting choice.

packages/estimator/src/selfhosted.ts|1.1.reason: Upper probe point either side of the breakeven crossover. Same plotting choice.

packages/estimator/src/selfhosted.ts|10.reason: Decade point on the breakeven volume curve.

packages/estimator/src/selfhosted.ts|100.reason: Percent conversion for share figures, and a decade point on the volume curve.
Decade point on the breakeven volume curve, and a per-1k unit conversion.
Decade point on the breakeven volume curve.
Decade point on the breakeven volume curve.

packages/estimator/src/selfhosted.ts|1e9.reason: Nano conversion for GB/ns-scale figures. Definitional.

packages/estimator/src/selfhosted.ts|30..reason: DAYS_PER_MONTH = 365.2425 / 12, the Gregorian mean. Used to amortize a monthly ops-labour figure per day. Calendar arithmetic, not a rate.

packages/estimator/src/text.ts|0.85.reason: MIXED_DOMINANCE_THRESHOLD — the share above which a document counts as single-script rather than mixed. A labelled bucket-selection parameter; §A4.5.4 governs what may then be applied to it.

packages/estimator/src/text.ts|3.reason: Arity of the fixed TokenTier ladder (0|1|2|3) and of fixed tuples in this file.

packages/ingest/src/compare.ts|100.reason: Percent scale for delta_pct. Unit conversion.

packages/ingest/src/compare.ts|1000.reason: Tokens per per_1k_tokens unit, in TOKENS_PER_UNIT. Unit scale, definitional.

packages/ingest/src/compare.ts|1000000.reason: Tokens per per_1m_tokens unit, in TOKENS_PER_UNIT. Unit scale, definitional.

packages/ingest/src/compare.ts|12.reason: DISPLAY_PRECISION — significant digits kept at the display boundary for a rescaled competing amount and a percentage. Rounding policy, not a rate.

packages/ingest/src/compare.ts|1e-9.reason: FLOAT_NOISE_PCT — below this two rescaled doubles are the same published figure. A float-equality epsilon, not a price tolerance; the price tolerance is a required parameter with no default.

packages/ingest/src/diff.ts|100.reason: Percent scale for PriceChangeEvent.delta_pct. Unit conversion.

packages/ingest/src/litellm.ts|1000.reason: TOKENS_PER_K — the k in a LiteLLM `*_above_200k_tokens` field name. Unit scale, definitional.

packages/ingest/src/litellm.ts|4.reason: Digit count of the year in the feed's YYYY-MM-DD deprecation_date regex. Structural.

packages/ingest/src/port.ts|200.reason: HTTP 200 returned by the fixture port. Protocol constant.

packages/ingest/src/snapshot.ts|200.reason: Lower bound of the HTTP 2xx success range. Protocol constant.

packages/ingest/src/snapshot.ts|300.reason: Exclusive upper bound of the HTTP 2xx success range. Protocol constant.

packages/parser/src/lexicon.ts|24.reason: NEGATION_WINDOW — characters of lookbehind when deciding whether a verb is negated. A parsing window, not a quantity in the cost math.

packages/parser/src/normalize.ts|10.reason: Chinese numeral 十. Part of the numeral table §A4.4.2 requires so digits are not dropped.

packages/parser/src/normalize.ts|100.reason: Chinese numeral 百. Same numeral table.

packages/parser/src/normalize.ts|1000.reason: Chinese numeral 千. Same numeral table.

packages/parser/src/normalize.ts|10000.reason: Chinese numeral 万, and its use as a multiplier when composing. Same numeral table.

packages/parser/src/normalize.ts|3.reason: Chinese numeral 三, and minimum stem lengths in the Arabic affix rules.

packages/parser/src/parse.ts|0.15.reason: PENALTY.MANY_SCRIPTS — parse-confidence weight, named in code (3.20).

packages/parser/src/parse.ts|0.2.reason: PENALTY.LONG_INSTRUCTION and PENALTY.CONDITIONAL_BRANCH — two parse-confidence weights that share a value, named in code (3.20).

packages/parser/src/parse.ts|0.25.reason: PENALTY.NEGATED_VERB_PRESENT — a parse-confidence weight, named in code (3.20). Author judgement, not a measurement; sized so any two penalties cross the 0.6 escalation floor.

packages/parser/src/parse.ts|0.6.reason: PARSE_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR — below this L1 escalates to L2 rather than emitting. A routing threshold.

packages/parser/src/parse.ts|100.reason: SCORE_DECIMALS — the score is reported to two decimals (× 100, ÷ 100 via one named constant). Rounding policy, not a rate.

packages/parser/src/parse.ts|600.reason: LONG_INSTRUCTION_CHARS — matchable-character length above which the long-instruction penalty applies. A threshold, not a rate.

packages/parser/src/quantities.ts|12.reason: Minimum stem length in a quantity-extraction pattern.

packages/router/src/split.ts|100.reason: Percent conversion when reporting a saving share.

packages/tokenizers/src/anthropic.ts|300.reason: Characters to keep when truncating an error message for a log line.

packages/tokenizers/src/anthropic.ts|500.reason: HTTP status boundary for server errors. Protocol.

packages/tokenizers/src/anthropic.ts|8.reason: Minimum key length before the redactor will substring-match it out of error text. A safety floor so a short accidental value cannot blank the whole message.

packages/tokenizers/src/cache.ts|16.reason: Hex width of the cache fingerprint, and the pad length that keeps it fixed-width.

packages/tokenizers/src/cache.ts|3.reason: Arity of a fixed tuple in this file.

packages/tokenizers/src/ladder.ts|3.reason: Highest rung of the §A4.5 tier ladder.
